_comment: The gate for Tier-2 headless CLI orchestration. Resting state per ADR-132 (owner decision 2026-08-25): claude is the Orchestrator seat but is locked behind requires_owner_approval - a job must carry owner_approved:true (recorded by whoever relays the owner's yes) before the claude rung is built; agy is the deputy, the first CLI rung, riding the Google AI Pro subscription; gemini stays OFF until the owner says otherwise. Daemon mode is banned outright and refused in code even if listed here. run_headless() re-reads this file on every call, so a flip takes effect immediately.

claude._note: THE ORCHESTRATOR SEAT (ADR-132): claude-sonnet-5, 1M context, measured $0.0078 for one hello. Enabled, but an agent can never invoke it on its own initiative: run_headless skips this rung unless the job carries owner_approved:true.

gemini._note: Official gemini CLI, subscription OAuth login only. No ADC, no API-key adapter, no daemon mode - ever (blocker B2). OFF until the owner decides otherwise.

agy._note: THE DEPUTY (ADR-132): first CLI rung, rides the Google AI Pro subscription with no visible per-call cost. Reached as 'agy --print <prompt>'. Handles what it can and hands the rest to the agent fleet; escalation to claude above needs owner_approved:true on the job. No daemon mode, no key flags.
